description: User-reported FAgent badcases. Keep entries chronological and do not delete fixed cases.

badcases.title: Self-introduction answer returned raw capability text
badcases.expected_answer: FAgent should use authoritative capability data as context, then synthesize a natural answer. It can summarize market analysis, strategy research, backtesting, optimization, and local paper trading, but must not simply stream the raw describe_fagent tool output.
badcases.actual_answer: The response was the full describe_fagent capability text, streamed almost directly as the final answer.

replay.notes: message_id is the user turn mid. Exact replay requires the local conversations database to retain this cid.

badcases.root_cause: ReActRouter.process_stream() special-cased TaskType.DESCRIBE_SELF and returned _run_self_description() directly, bypassing model synthesis.
badcases.fix: Use describe_fagent as an authoritative context source, then let the model write the final answer.
verification: API smoke test confirmed the query now returns a synthesized overview

badcases.title: Specific market-capability question repeated full self-introduction
badcases.query: 你现在能查询最新数据行情吗？
badcases.expected_answer: FAgent should directly answer that it can query stock market data when given a stock name or code, explain the relevant quote/K-line/trend-analysis flow, and mention data-source/cache limits without repeating the complete capability overview.
badcases.actual_answer: The response was effectively the same full capability description returned for 你有哪些功能？.

replay.notes: message_id is the user turn mid. Exact replay requires the local conversations database to retain this cid.

badcases.root_cause: The router could classify focused capability questions as describe_self. There was no separate task type for concrete ability or boundary questions, and direct passthrough of describe_fagent made the duplicate answer obvious.
badcases.fix: Add TaskType.CAPABILITY_QA for concrete capability questions, normalize overbroad describe_self decisions to capability_qa, and instruct the model not to invent details absent from the authoritative capability data.
verification: API smoke test confirmed the query now answers only the market-data capability question
API smoke test confirmed no unsupported concrete latency claim was added

badcases.title: Market data date question did not use offline fallback
badcases.query: 那你能查询得到贵州茅台最近的行情数据是什么时候的呢？
badcases.expected_answer: When live market data tools fail, FAgent should fall back to the local QuantMInd offline daily dataset for A-share daily data. For 贵州茅台/600519, it should answer that the latest locally available trading date is 2026-04-24, clearly state this is offline stale daily data rather than realtime data, and optionally summarize the latest available K-line/recent daily range.
badcases.actual_answer: FAgent said all prior live market tool calls failed and therefore it had no returned data and could not know the last successful market data date.

replay.notes: message_id is the user turn mid. Exact replay requires the local conversations database to retain this cid.

badcases.root_cause: The market tools currently rely on live AKShare/DatasetManager paths for quote, K-line, trend, and search. BacktestDataLoader already knows how to read QuantMInd feature snapshots, but MarketService does not yet use that offline source as a fallback.
badcases.fix: Pending. Add a shared offline QuantMInd daily-data provider and wire it into market quote/K-line/trend/search fallback paths.
